Finding B4 of the second DDD pass (#139). Severity: low-medium.

#65 removed the doubled side vocabulary on the Python side ("defined twice, held in step by a comment"); the SQF context has re-grown the same shape. The addon hand-rolls the side-name↔engine-side vocabulary five times:

- `fn_effectApply.sqf:90–94` — name→engine side `switch`.
- `fn_leaderSquad.sqf:52–56` — engine side→name `switch`.
- `fn_contactSample.sqf:80` — hand-built enemy-of table `[["WEST", east], ["EAST", west]]`.
- `fn_presenceSample.sqf:34` — hardcoded `["WEST", "EAST"]` list instead of the exported schema's `sides`. This is the fail-silent copy: presence on a side the literal does not list is simply never reported, which is the shape #44's `CTI_DAEMON_ADDR` lesson warns about (a boundary nothing asserts on).
- `fn_orderApply.sqf:56` — the `toUpper str (side _group)` idiom as a fourth spelling of the same translation.

The daemon already exports `sides` in `command-schema.json`; the engine-side objects (`west`/`east`) are the one half SQF must own. One helper (or one derived hashmap built at `worldInit` beside `cti_basesBySide`) can carry both directions and the enemy-of relation, with the five sites reading it.

Acceptance criteria:

- [ ] One place in the addon owns name↔engine-side translation (both directions) and enemy-of; the five sites read it.
- [ ] `fn_presenceSample` selects sides from the exported schema (or the derived table), not a literal.
- [ ] `just fast` green; `just regress` (full corpus, no filter) before landing, since this touches `addons/`.
